def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    product_set = set(entity_ids)
    mask = order_items["product_id"].isin(product_set) & (order_items["ts"] < seed_time)
    items = order_items.loc[mask, ["order_id", "product_id", "seller_id", "price", "freight_value", "ts"]].copy()

    # Заказы: берём только их "паспортные" атрибуты, известные на момент покупки
    orders_sub = orders[["order_id", "customer_id"]].copy()
    orders_sub = orders_sub[orders_sub["order_id"].isin(set(items["order_id"]))]

    # Статус/даты доставки: учитываем доставку только если она уже случилась до seed_time
    delivered_ids = set(
        orders.loc[
            (orders["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time),
            "order_id"
        ]
    )
    shipped_ids = set(
        orders.loc[
            (orders["order_delivered_carrier_date"] < seed_time),
            "order_id"
        ]
    )
    approved_ids = set(
        orders.loc[
            (orders["order_approved_at"] < seed_time),
            "order_id"
        ]
    )

    items = items.merge(orders_sub, on="order_id", how="left")

    items["is_delivered"] = items["order_id"].isin(delivered_ids).astype(int)
    items["is_shipped"] = items["order_id"].isin(shipped_ids).astype(int)
    items["is_approved"] = items["order_id"].isin(approved_ids).astype(int)

    # Платежи: учитываем только те, что появились до seed_time
    pay_agg = (
        payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
        .groupby("order_id")
        .agg(
            install_mean=("payment_installments", "mean"),
            total_pay=("payment_value", "sum"),
            credit_share=("payment_type", lambda s: (s == "credit_card").mean()),
            debit_share=("payment_type", lambda s: (s == "debit_card").mean()),
            voucher_share=("payment_type", lambda s: (s == "voucher").mean()),
            pay_count=("payment_type", "size"),
        )
    )

    # Отзывы: только написанные до seed_time
    rev_agg = (
        reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time]
        .groupby("order_id")
        .agg(
            rev_count=("review_id", "count"),
            rev_avg=("review_score", "mean"),
            rev_std=("review_score", "std"),
            rev_min=("review_score", "min"),
            rev_max=("review_score", "max"),
        )
    )

    items = items.merge(pay_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    items = items.merge(rev_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    if items.empty:
        result = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids))
        cols = [
            "order_count", "unique_orders", "unique_customers", "unique_sellers",
            "total_price", "avg_price", "std_price", "max_price", "min_price",
            "total_freight", "avg_freight", "freight_ratio",
            "cnt_30", "cnt_60", "cnt_90", "cnt_180", "cnt_365",
            "delivered_share", "shipped_share", "approved_share",
            "avg_review", "std_review", "total_reviews", "rev_min", "rev_max", "review_rate",
            "avg_installments", "avg_payment_value", "credit_share", "debit_share",
            "voucher_share", "paid_over_price",
            "last_purchase_days", "first_purchase_days", "avg_daily_orders",
            "median_interarrival", "trend_90_180",
        ]
        for c in cols:
            result[c] = 0.0
        return result.reindex(entity_ids)

    items["cnt_30"] = (items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)).astype(int)
    items["cnt_60"] = (items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=60)).astype(int)
    items["cnt_90"] = (items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)).astype(int)
    items["cnt_180"] = (items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)).astype(int)
    items["cnt_365"] = (items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=365)).astype(int)

    g = items.groupby("product_id")
    feat = g.agg(
        order_count=("order_id", "count"),
        unique_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        unique_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        total_price=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        cnt_30=("cnt_30", "sum"),
        cnt_60=("cnt_60", "sum"),
        cnt_90=("cnt_90", "sum"),
        cnt_180=("cnt_180", "sum"),
        cnt_365=("cnt_365", "sum"),
        delivered_share=("is_delivered", "mean"),
        shipped_share=("is_shipped", "mean"),
        approved_share=("is_approved", "mean"),
        avg_review=("rev_avg", "mean"),
        std_review=("rev_std", "mean"),
        total_reviews=("rev_count", "sum"),
        rev_min=("rev_min", "mean"),
        rev_max=("rev_max", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("install_mean", "mean"),
        avg_payment_value=("total_pay", "mean"),
        credit_share=("credit_share", "mean"),
        debit_share=("debit_share", "mean"),
        voucher_share=("voucher_share", "mean"),
        paid_over_price=("total_pay", "mean"),
        max_ts=("ts", "max"),
        min_ts=("ts", "min"),
    )

    feat["review_rate"] = feat["total_reviews"] / feat["unique_orders"].clip(lower=1)
    feat["freight_ratio"] = feat["total_freight"] / feat["total_price"].clip(lower=0.01)

    # Средний интервал между покупками товара
    def _interarrival(s):
        t = np.sort(s.values)
        if len(t) < 2:
            return np.nan
        return np.median(np.diff(t).astype("timedelta64[D]").astype(float))

    feat["median_interarrival"] = g["ts"].apply(_interarrival)

    # Тренд: активность последних 90 дней против предыдущих 90
    feat["trend_90_180"] = (feat["cnt_90"] - (feat["cnt_180"] - feat["cnt_90"])) / feat["unique_orders"].clip(lower=1)

    last_purchase_days = (seed_time - feat["max_ts"]) / pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    first_purchase_days = (seed_time - feat["min_ts"]) / pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    feat["last_purchase_days"] = last_purchase_days
    feat["first_purchase_days"] = first_purchase_days
    feat["avg_daily_orders"] = feat["order_count"] / first_purchase_days.clip(lower=1)

    feat = feat.drop(columns=["max_ts", "min_ts"])

    feat = feat.fillna(0.0)

    result = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids))
    result = result.join(feat, how="left")
    result = result.fillna(0.0)
    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
    return result
